def extract_text_features(text):
    features = []
    
    # Basic length features
    features.append(len(str(text)))
    
    # Character counts for common patterns
    text_lower = str(text).lower()
    features.extend([text_lower.count('a'), text_lower.count('е'), text_lower.count('o')])
    
    # Digit patterns
    digit_count = len(re.findall(r'\d', str(text)))
    decimal_pos = text.find('.')
    features.append(digit_count)
    if decimal_pos >= 0:
        features.append(decimal_pos)
    
    # Initial letter encoding
    initial = str(text)[0] if str(text) else ''
    if len(initial) <= 20:
        features.extend([initial])
    
    return np.array(features)
